courses.title: Cloud Platforms for Data Work
courses.description: Cloud Platforms for Data Work takes you from the basics of cloud platforms to applying it on a realistic Data Analyst scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to stakeholder communication, enough to use it alongside cloud platforms day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying cloud platforms to a real Data Analyst scenario
Practicing cloud platforms through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to stakeholder communication
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Data Governance for Practitioners
courses.description: Data Governance for Practitioners is a focused course on data governance for people already working toward a Data Analyst role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying data governance on your own.

Practicing data governance through guided exercises
Building a short data governance exercise from scratch

The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if cloud platforms is new to you.
